clue.text: Pass, or do a detour to get here?

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

indicators.note: a detour takes a roundabout route, so the letters of these words wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller is told to take a mountain pass or a long way round to reach some destination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detour' is the anagram signal. The definition 'here' is the destination itself, a US state, so the whole clue also hints at where the pass leads.
explanation.definitionFit: The destination reached is a US state in the Rockies, a place where the clue's traveller arrives.

clue.text: Bird dog we sent back around the lake

indicators.note: the first pieces go round the second

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: sending back means reversing, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A gun dog is sent back around a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' reverses the second word, and 'around' wraps both dog and reversed word round the lake's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a long-billed wading bird of moors and shores.

clue.text: Naughty boy in a cap, that's clear

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: a lid is a cap
an imp is a mischievous child

explanation.surface: A mischievous boy in a cap seems to be all that is plain to see.
explanation.definitionFit: It means transparent, as of water you can see through.

clue.text: Snake coils around a boy

indicators.note: the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: rings are coils
Hal is a boy's name, short for Henry

explanation.surface: A snake wraps itself around a boy.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a variant spelling of rinkhals, the South African spitting cobra, so it may look unfamiliar.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a southern African spitting cobra.

clue.text: Nest that's waterproof with first egg inside

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: something waterproof stays dry

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A nest is kept dry with its first egg tucked in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' takes E from egg, put 'inside' DRY.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the twig nest built by a squirrel.

clue.text: A goddess? The e young lady is just too short

indicators.note: being just too short means the word falls one letter shy of its full length, so its final letter goes

parts.note: Miss is the title of a young unmarried lady

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a young woman is divine, only to dismiss her as slightly too short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is just too short' docks the title by one letter, as someone not quite tall enough falls short.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the Greek Titaness who personifies divine law and justice.

clue.text: Receive information about the French doctor

indicators.note: one piece goes round the other

parts.note: to hear is to receive news
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone gets news concerning a French physician.
explanation.definitionFit: One who cures people is a general term for a physician.

clue.text: Doctor to telephone when taking to the road

parts.note: MO is a medical officer
to ring is to telephone

explanation.surface: A doctor phones when setting out on a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving a car along the highway is what taking to the road means.

clue.text: Sink full I of broken beer mugs

indicators.note: broken pieces are rearranged, so the letters change order

explanation.surface: A kitchen sink is piled with smashed glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: To sink is to go under the water.

clue.text: Men ride furiously, then run—-it jogs the memory

indicators.note: riding furiously suggests wild disorder, so these letters are thrown about

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Horsemen gallop wildly and then dash off, somehow prompting a recollection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'furiously' scrambles MEN RIDE into REMINDE, and R for run completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: A prompt or memo is something that jogs the memory.

clue.text: Worker goes in taxi belonging to a well-known seat of learning

definitions.text: belonging to a well-known seat of learning

indicators.note: one piece going in another is placed inside it

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
the worker ant is the crossword's stock worker

explanation.surface: A labourer climbs into a taxi bound for a famous university.
explanation.walkthrough: Cantab is short for Cantabrigian, of Cambridge University.
explanation.definitionFit: The short form of Cantabrigian describes things from Cambridge University, a famous seat of learning.

clue.text: Quickest way out of the crush

definitions.meaning: a fast train or delivery service is the swiftest option
to squeeze juice or oil out of something by pressing

explanation.surface: Someone seeks the fastest way to escape a crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast train is the swiftest route, and to squeeze liquid from fruit by pressing has the same verb.

clue.text: Prophet priest has confounded

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Old Testament book of Samuel

indicators.note: confounded means thrown into confusion, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A priest is left baffled, sounding like a religious anecdote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confounded' rearranges ELI plus HAS into the Old Testament prophet who followed Elijah.
explanation.definitionFit: He is an Old Testament prophet, successor to Elijah.

clue.text: Cruelly axe large pine perhaps, just to make this rod?

indicators.note: doing something cruelly suggests mangling, so these letters are twisted into a new shape

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
a pine is one example of a tree

explanation.surface: Someone hacks down a big pine with an axe merely to make a pole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cruelly' is the anagram signal for the axe and the size letter, with the pine example following.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the bar or shaft on which a pair of wheels turns.

clue.text: Place first obstruction in river, then drain

indicators.note: these go inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: let means an obstacle, as in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: Someone sets an obstacle in a river to empty it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' gives P from Place; P and LET go 'in' DEE.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhaust or use up a supply is to drain it.

clue.text: Using this, those who write letters expect to get answers

definitions.text: Using this, those who write letters expect to get answers

parts.words: Using this, those who write letters expect to get answers
parts.note: seems to be about correspondents awaiting replies, but describes the mathematics where letters stand for numbers and equations are solved

explanation.surface: Letter writers rely on something to make sure they get replies.
explanation.definitionFit: In this branch of mathematics, symbols like x and y are written and the equations solved to give answers.

clue.text: Intimate the weapons are to be withdrawn

indicators.note: withdrawn suggests pulling back, so the word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: guns are weapons

explanation.surface: A hint is dropped that arms will be pulled out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be withdrawn' turns GUNS back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Intimate in the sense of cosy and close is a synonym.

clue.text: Tank water with liquor I swallow

parts.note: aqua is Latin for water

indicators.note: swallowing takes something inside, so I goes into the drink

parts.note: rum is a liquor

explanation.surface: Someone downs water mixed with spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a glass tank in which fish are kept.

clue.text: Don't care so much about being stupid

definitions.meaning: to ... is to be less bothered

explanation.surface: Someone says they are less concerned about being foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means caring less; as one word it means senseless or brainless.

clue.text: Giant tilting object Don's misconception

definitions.meaning: a giant that is tilted at, the target of a lance
Don Quixote mistook these for giants

explanation.surface: A huge leaning structure turns out to be an academic's error.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cervantes' novel, Don Quixote charges at sails he takes for giants; tilting means jousting.
explanation.definitionFit: The knight Don Quixote famously jousted at a mill with sails, believing it was a giant.

clue.text: A pound for tobacco?

definitions.meaning: British slang for one pound sterling

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a pound will buy their tobacco.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for a pound coin, and also a wad of tobacco for chewing.

clue.text: Synthetic stuff finally seen in the small picture

indicators.note: being seen in something means placed inside it

parts.note: pic is a short form of picture
at last means finally

explanation.surface: Some artificial material appears at last in a little photograph.
explanation.definitionFit: It names the man-made polymer material used for countless objects.

clue.text: Drop a quarter and just get by

parts.note: to scrap a plan is to drop it
E for east is one of the four compass quarters

explanation.surface: Someone loses a coin and barely manages.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'quarter' in crosswords is a compass point: N, S, E or W.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrape by is to manage with difficulty.

clue.text: Boat giving protection from shells?

definitions.meaning: a canoe hollowed out of a log

explanation.surface: A boat is said to shield its occupants from shells.
explanation.definitionFit: A canoe hewn from a log, and a dug shelter against shellfire in trench warfare.

clue.text: Man set out to find this in blossom

indicators.note: out signals the letters are set in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A man goes looking for something in a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the pollen-bearing male organ of a flower.

clue.text: Face bungling in a CIA duty

indicators.note: bungling means clumsy mishandling, so the letters are muddled

explanation.surface: Someone confronts clumsiness in an American intelligence task.
explanation.definitionFit: Face as a noun means cheek or nerve, a bold impudence.

clue.text: Publicity fair? Correct!

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
just means fair

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether a piece of publicity is fair and is told yes.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct something slightly is to tweak or fine-tune it.

clue.text: Shell hospital by English river

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
the Usk is a river of Wales and the Welsh border

explanation.surface: A shell is found at a hospital beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the dry outer covering of a seed or grain.

clue.text: Frozen slab of mushroom the boy has eaten

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: Ian is a typical boy's name
a cep is a kind of mushroom, the porcino

explanation.surface: A lad has consumed some mushroom, a homely meal.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a flat piece of floating sea ice.

clue.text: Young creature I mould in this shape

parts.note: a cub is a young animal such as a fox or bear
to form is to mould

explanation.surface: A youngster is told to mould something into a certain shape.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the adjective for having the shape of a cube.

clue.text: Collection of peacocks an essential for the Queen

parts.note: a must is an essential
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: Peacocks are presented as a necessity for the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the collective noun for a group of peacocks.

clue.text: Something hidden in the cupboard? You need this key

definitions.meaning: the idiom of a family's guilty secret, the bones in the closet
a key that opens many locks

explanation.surface: Someone is told which key opens the cupboard where something is hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: A guilty secret is the bones in the cupboard, and a master key filed to fit many locks takes the same name.
